Game Overview

In Zombie Massacre, the core idea is straightforward: unleash chaos in the Wild West as you fend off relentless zombie hordes in Zombie Massacre. Collect coins to unlock powerful weapons, hire allies, and upgrade your arsenal. Protect the innocent, strategize your moves, and watch the undead fall as you restore peace in this thrilling shoot-'em-up adventure!
